hook: orphan 飲食團來補給：ravenous／voracious／satiated／parsimonious——有人狂吃，有人把餅乾鎖抽屜。
script: ravenous／voracious 極餓貪吃。satiated 飽足。parsimonious 吝嗇。glutton 貪食者。口令：補給站寫「適量」，鎖抽屜寫「考試別分心」。

members.senseAnchor: extremely hungry; devouring or craving food in great quantities
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 狼吞: ravenous walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「狼吞」出場：ravenous 一上場梗就黏住——極餓的。

related.synonyms: famished, sharp-set, starved, esurient, edacious, rapacious
